title: Part Nine: Debt: Financing the Dream

sections.brief: Household debt by type (NY Fed Q2 2026 $18.771tn; history from $12.68tn 2008 peak); debt service ratio 11.11% vs 15.85% peak; card APRs (G.19, 11.85% 2013 to ~21% 2023-26; 22.36% assessed interest Aug 2026) and CFPB margin finding vs CBA rebuttal; Marquette 1978, South Dakota/Citibank 1981, Smiley 1996, Colorado opt-out en banc (status Oct 2026); minimum-payment arithmetic ($5,000 at 22.36% = 231 months, ~$8,240 interest) and CARD Act disclosures; FICO 1989 and weights; FTC 2012 errors (26%/13%/5%); CFPB 2025 credit-invisible correction (2.7%, ~7m); VantageScore 4.0 at GSEs (Sep 2026); medical-debt rule vacated; Fed 2007 benefits of scoring. Figures: stats; time; money; compare (told vs record)

Overdraft/NSF: 1969 TILA exemption; CFPB revenue $11.96bn (2019) to $5.83bn (2023, banks >$1bn), concentration (under 9% pay ~80%); NCLC ~$12.4bn 2025 (different scope); Dec 2024 $5 rule and its CRA repeal (PL 119-10, 9 May 2025, votes); ABA position; $8 late-fee rule vacated 15 Apr 2025 on joint motion; CFPB funding litigation (Sept 2026); FDIC 2023 unbanked 4.2%, reasons, gaps by circumstance; SHED 2025 94%/77%; check-cashing (NY cap, $572/yr arithmetic) and prepaid rule 2019; counter-evidence (voluntary fee cuts, unbanked halved). Figures: money; time; stats

Payday APR arithmetic (391%), CFPB 2014 rollovers, Pew 2012 profile, state caps (CRL 21+DC), MLA 36%, 2017 rule history and Oct 2026 status, CFSA position, Morse 2011; BNPL (CFPB 2025 report, SHED 16%/11%, interpretive rule withdrawn May 2025); EWA/cash-advance apps (DFPI 2021 ~334% APR, CFPB Dec 2025 advisory opinion, FTC v Brigit, US v Dave status); medical credit cards (CFPB 2023, deferred interest arithmetic, CareCredit 2013); labelled Interpretation passage (poverty premium) with counter-readings. Figures: flow; money; compare (designed vs deviant friction)
